import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
d13 = df[df.dt=='2025-10-13']
d12 = df[df.dt=='2025-10-12']
base = df[df.dt<'2025-10-13'].groupby('dt')['unblended_cost'].sum().mean()
print('baseline mean', base, 'day13', d13.unblended_cost.sum())
for c in ['csp','cloud_service','application']:

    b = p[p.index<'2025-10-13'].mean()
    diff = p.loc[pd.Timestamp('2025-10-13')] - b
    print('\n==',c)
    print(diff.sort_values(ascending=False).to_string())

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
sub = df[(df.cloud_service=='h92it') & (df.application=='ap3')]
p = sub.pivot_table(index='dt', columns='instance_family', values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
b = p[p.index<'2025-10-13'].mean()
diff = (p.loc[pd.Timestamp('2025-10-13')] - b).sort_values(ascending=False)
print(diff.to_string())
print()
# price and instances for the top ones
top = diff[diff>1].index.tolist()
for f in top:
    s = sub[sub.instance_family==f][['dt','price','num_instances','unblended_cost']]
    print('\n',f)
    print(s[s.dt>='2025-10-05'].to_string())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')

# any price changes per instance_family across whole period?
g = df.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['price'].nunique()
print('families with price variation:', (g>1).sum())
print(g[g>1])

# num_instances step change detection per family: compare pre vs post 10/13
pre = df[df.dt<'2025-10-13']; post = df[df.dt>='2025-10-13']
keys=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
a = pre.groupby(keys).agg(cost=('unblended_cost','mean'), inst=('num_instances','mean'), price=('price','mean'))
b = post.groupby(keys).agg(cost=('unblended_cost','mean'), inst=('num_instances','mean'), price=('price','mean'))
m = a.join(b, lsuffix='_pre', rsuffix='_post')
m['delta']=m.cost_post-m.cost_pre
print(m.sort_values('delta',ascending=False).head(12).to_string())
print(m.sort_values('delta').head(8).to_string())

## Analysis

**Daily total cost** for account CZ4NH6K was ~$7,200/day through 2025-10-12, then jumped to **$8,187.57 on 2025-10-13** and stayed elevated (~$8,100/day) — a persistent step change, not a one-day blip.

**Decomposition** of the +$978.88 jump vs. the pre-anomaly baseline:

| Dimension | Contribution |
|---|---|
| CSP = GCP | +$953.27 |
| cloud_service = h92it | +$995.87 |
| application = ap3 | +$914.01 |
| **instance_family = HRNHGYQxfj** | **+$907.29** |

**Root cause evidence for `HRNHGYQxfj`:**
- Price constant at 1.450 for the entire period (no price change anywhere in the dataset — verified 0 instance families have price variation).
- `num_instances` cycled in a bounded 0–27 range through 10/12, then jumped to **41 on 2025-10-13 and stayed pinned at 41 every day afterward** — a permanent scaling change.
- Cost: $487.20 on 10/12 → **$1,426.80 on 10/13** (max value in the whole dataset), +$907.29 vs. its own $519.51 baseline average.

All other instance families show only normal day-to-day noise (|Δ| < $3 between pre/post period means), so no other resource is a root cause.
